title: Rum Cream Pie
description: A light, frozen no-bake pie of whipped egg yolks and sugar set with a little gelatin, flavored with rum extract, folded into stiff whipped cream and frozen in a graham cracker crust.

portion.size: 1/8 of the pie (1 slice: about 1/3 cup filling plus crust)

instructions: Dissolve 1 tsp gelatin in 1/8 cup (2 tbsp) hot water.
Beat 3 egg yolks and 1/2 cup sugar until light.
Beat the gelatin water into the egg mixture, then let it cool.
Beat 1 cup heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
Add 1 tbsp rum extract to the egg mixture.
Combine the egg mixture with the whipped cream. Don't overmix, or the whipped cream will become runny.
Pour into the graham cracker crust and freeze until firm.
notes: A traditional family recipe. We've been warned not to double it, and the original recipe holder uses half the gelatin (1/2 tsp). Macros assume a store-bought 9-inch graham cracker crust (about 100 cal / 1g protein / 13g carb / 5g fat per 1/8); the filling alone is about 177 cal / 2g protein / 14g carb / 13g fat per slice. Freeze at least 4 hours (or overnight) before slicing. The egg yolks aren't cooked, so use pasteurized eggs if that's a concern.
